gripOrHq.title: Forged Activation Orders
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

gripOrHq.title: Inside Job
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

gripOrHq.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

heapOrArchives.title: Rigged Investments
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Zetatech Software Installer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: All-Nighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

heapOrArchives.title: Deep Thought
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Thought counter. Three or more Thought counters allow you to look at the top card of R&D at the start of each of your turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Crash Everett, Inventive Fixer
rig.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards from your stack, draw an extra card; then choose one of the cards drawn and either trash it or return it to the top of your stack. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

rig.title: Silicon Saloon Franchise
rig.rulesText: A: Gain [1] and draw one card.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

ice.title: Mastermind
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 brain damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Mastermind. *End the run. Mastermind has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

root.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
root.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

ice.title: Washed-Up Solo Construct
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Washed-Up Solo Construct.

ice.title: Coyote
ice.rulesText: *For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +1 strength, unless Runner pays [2] while passing Coyote. Gain [3] when you rez Coyote.

ice.title: Dog Pile
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

root.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
root.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Tesseract Fort Construction
root.rulesText: All ice on this fort has an additional subroutine, "*End the run unless Runner pays [1]," after all other subroutines.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.
